package migr

import (
	"math/rand"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type Pool struct {
	wd    *dst.World
	mu    sync.Mutex
	jobs  chan int
	done  chan struct{}
	notes <-chan string
	t     *time.Timer
}

// run handles jobs until done.
func (p *Pool) run(out chan<- int) int {
	n := 0
	for {
		select {
		case j, ok := <-p.jobs:
			if !ok {
				return n
			}
			if j < 0 {
				continue
			}
			// a comment inside a case
			out <- j * 2
			n++
		case <-p.done:
			return n
		case <-time.After(time.Second):
			break
		case s := <-p.notes:
			select { // a nested select
			case p.jobs <- len(s):
			case <-p.done:
				return n
			}
		case out <- -1:
		default:
			time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
		}
	}
}

func (p *Pool) start() {
	p.jobs = make(chan int, 4)
	p.done = make(chan struct{})
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	go p.worker(rand.Intn(3))
	go func() { close(p.done) }()
	if p.notes == nil || len(p.jobs) > 2 {
		p.jobs <- 1
	}
	v := <-p.jobs
	_ = v
	for x := range p.jobs {
		_ = x
	}
	_ = time.Now()
}

func (p *Pool) worker(i int) { _ = i; _ = <-p.jobs + 1 }

func dstRecv[T any](c dst.Chan[T]) T { v, _ := c.Recv(); return v }
